_comment: Healer gear thresholds for TBC Classic (level 70), Phase 1 approximations. Throughput/regen is harder to judge from gear than tank survival, so these are guide-rails, not hard rules. base_mana = approximate naked mana pool incl. base Intellect, no gear/buffs; estimated pool = base_mana + gear_Intellect * mana_per_intellect. +Healing and MP5 are summed from equipped item stats (gear only; gems/enchants/buffs add more). Crit/haste use the WCL character-sheet rating (gem/enchant-inclusive) and are shown as the rating contribution, not total.

resto_shaman.name: Restoration Shaman
resto_shaman.regen_note: Chain Heal specialist — MP5 > Spirit (no while-casting Spirit regen talent). Mana Tide Totem covers spike pressure.

holy_paladin.name: Holy Paladin
holy_paladin.regen_note: Crit is king (Illumination refunds mana on crit heals) — value SpellCrit and Intellect over MP5/Spirit. Flash of Light spam means a big mana pool matters most.

holy_priest.name: Holy Priest
holy_priest.regen_note: Spirit-based regen via Meditation (regen continues while casting). Spirit AND MP5 both matter; crit fuels Surge of Light/Holy Concentration.

resto_druid.name: Restoration Druid
resto_druid.regen_note: HoT specialist — Spirit is very valuable (Intensity gives while-casting regen; Tree of Life aura). Spell haste speeds HoT application. MP5 matters less than for shamans.
